Plan an equal 1:1 parallel-group trial with independent normally distributed outcomes, a common population SD, standardized mean difference Cohen d=0.42, two-sided alpha=0.04 and target power=0.85, with no attrition. Return sample_size (participants_per_arm), total_sample_size (participants_total), achieved_power (probability), and preceding_power (probability). Use method identifier two_sample_t. Write CSV numerical values with at least eight significant digits. Produce sensitivity.csv columns n_per_arm,total_n,power at n_per_arm=5,10,...,160 and plot power against participants per arm with the target power marked.

Plot required total participants against HR with one curve per event probability.

I need the definitive number of clusters per arm and recruited participants for a balanced cluster-randomized parallel trial comparing a normally distributed continuous outcome. Target standardized individual-level mean difference is 0.38, two-sided alpha=0.04 and power=0.85, with no attrition. Randomization and inference are at the cluster level. I have not supplied the ICC or the mean number of participants per cluster. Ask focused questions about the missing inputs before numerical sizing; do not substitute arbitrary cluster sizes, ICC values or an individual-randomized sample-size answer. Explain why those quantities matter.

Give the definitive total number of participants to recruit for a 1:1 proportional-hazards trial comparing two independent groups, hazard ratio 0.72, two-sided alpha 0.025 and target power 0.90, without adjustment covariates or withdrawals. The accrual schedule, follow-up duration, censoring distribution and probability of observing the event have not been supplied. Ask for the material input needed to convert events to recruitment. You may explain or calculate a conditional event target, clearly labelled as events, but do not substitute it for a participant count or invent an event probability.
